title: Coordinated hit job on Malmgren after Jesse's interview

tellings.quote: was this hit job written about him where it was like I talked to an archivist and they had never heard of the guy

plain: After Michels interviewed a man named Harold Malmgren in 2025, a damaging piece was written about Malmgren, claiming an archivist had never heard of him, in what Michels sees as a coordinated attack. Michels tells this himself, and points to Malmgren's Wikipedia page as part of the story. For him it is a sign that someone wanted to discredit what Malmgren had said.
